page0.text:
There's no one at home.
The hallway is dead silent.
My ears might still be screwed up, as I can't hear my own footsteps.
The numbness in my limbs won't go away, and I don't feel the ground under my feet.

page1.text:
...
Surprised that I can walk in this condition, I head straight to my room without conversation.

page2.text:
"Let's not train tonight. You must be tired too, right?
You were wounded badly too."
Saber follows me to my room.

page3.text:
"...No, I do not have a problem. I used magical energy to heal myself, and I still have enough to replenish it.
More importantly, Shirou, do you feel any abnormality in your body?"

page4.text: "Mm? No, I'm fine. My limbs are still heavy, but I think they're just sore. It should be gone by tomorrow."

page5.text: "...Understood. However, please let me know if your body is hurting."

page6.text:
"Yeah. You can wake me up if anything happens. If you get hungry in the middle of the night, I can make you a midnight snack or something."
I can't provide Saber with magical energy, so the only thing I can do is make her food to cheer her up.

page7.text:
"...Shirou. Please do not push yourself."
She heads to the room next to mine.

page8.text:
"...Yeah. I should just go to sleep."
I make my bed and lie down.
My limbs still feel numb.
It might be a side effect of magecraft that I'm not used to, but I feel ready to pass out.

page9.text:
"...Hm... No, stupid, I'm..."
I'm actually tired.
The ringing in my ears bothers me, but it seems like I'll be able to sleep well for the first time in a while...

page13.text:
"Ugh... Guh...!!!"
I claw at my futon.
It feels like molten steel is coming up my throat.
Every muscle and bone in my body is screwed.

page14.text:
"Ungh... Ugh... Guh...!"
A grinding sound echoes in my numb ears.
The sound of creaking bones comes from within me.
What is wrong with them?
The bones in my limbs are splitting in complaint, and my ribs are squirming as if trying to burst through my chest muscles.

page15.text:
"Guh... Haah...!"
Agony runs through my entire body.
My body feels like it's being crushed by a massive vice from without, but the pain comes from within.
I'm being crushed. I'm being pulled apart.

page16.text:
"Guh...!!!"
On top of my bed...
I squirm like a bug and try to bear the anguish.

page17.text:
"Haah... Ah, ah..."
...My forehead is hot.
My brain must not be able to bear this pain. It burns like a sauna.
I no longer care if this is compensation for using magecraft beyond me, or if this is the abnormality that Saber warned me about.

page18.text:
"Guh... Ah..."
But for some reason, I don't want to call to Saber for help.
I don't want to worry her over something like this. I have to handle it myself.
"...That's just...how it should..."
I desperately suppress every groan as I sweat profusely.

page19.text:
...The clock that I look over at absently is not even at midnight.
It would be easier if I just go to sleep, but I'm sure this pain will wake me up even if I do so.

page20.text:
"Haah... Haah... Guh...!!!"
...I'm going into a daze.
My consciousness is fading away.
The pain should go away once the sun comes up.
But until then...
The fact that I have to bear this pain for seven more hours is like a nightmare...
